shared_widgets.name: LumenAppBar
shared_widgets.description: Top app bar with Lumen wordmark, optional back, search icon (min 48dp), cart icon with CartBadgeChip showing item count from CartNotifier; semantic labels on all actions.

shared_widgets.name: CartBadgeChip
shared_widgets.description: Circular 20dp min badge using cartBadge/onCartBadge tokens; hides when count zero; Semantics label includes item count.

shared_widgets.name: PrimaryButton
shared_widgets.description: Filled button primary/onPrimary, min height 48dp, full-width on forms; loading shows inline CircularProgressIndicator.

shared_widgets.name: SecondaryButton
shared_widgets.description: Filled secondary/onSecondary for accent CTAs (e.g. Apply coupon); min height 48dp.

shared_widgets.name: OutlinedButton
shared_widgets.description: 1dp outline border, onSurface text; used for secondary actions (Continue shopping, Retry).

shared_widgets.name: TextButton
shared_widgets.description: Text-only actions (Forgot password, View all); min tap target 48dp via padding.

shared_widgets.name: ProductCard
shared_widgets.description: Thumbnail 1:1 aspect, title (max 2 lines), price from pence via MoneyFormatter, optional OOS badge; tap navigates to product detail.

shared_widgets.name: ProductGrid
shared_widgets.description: Responsive 2-column grid with spacing tokens; supports pull-to-refresh on listing screens.

shared_widgets.name: HorizontalProductCarousel
shared_widgets.description: Snap carousel for featured/new arrivals on home; exposes Semantics header per section.

shared_widgets.name: CategoryTile
shared_widgets.description: Square tile with image or icon, category name; min 48dp touch target.

shared_widgets.name: SearchBarField
shared_widgets.description: Read-only tap opens Product Listing with focus; or embedded TextField on listing with debounced query to API.

shared_widgets.name: FilterSortBar
shared_widgets.description: Chip row: Sort bottom sheet, Filters bottom sheet with active filter count badge.

shared_widgets.name: FilterBottomSheet
shared_widgets.description: Multi-select filters: price range slider, brand, category, wattage, finish, availability; Apply/Clear actions.

shared_widgets.name: SortBottomSheet
shared_widgets.description: Radio list: price asc/desc, newest, popularity (seed weight).

shared_widgets.name: VariantSelector
shared_widgets.description: Chip group for finish, wattage, color temperature; updates price, SKU, stock from selected variant.

shared_widgets.name: SpecsTable
shared_widgets.description: Two-column key-value list for lighting attributes (wattage, lumens, CCT, IP, dimmable, dimensions).

shared_widgets.name: QuantityStepper
shared_widgets.description: Minus/plus with 48dp targets; enforces max stock; shows inline error on oversell.

shared_widgets.name: MoneyFormatter
shared_widgets.description: Formats integer GBP pence to major units with £ prefix and 2 decimals; used on all price surfaces.

shared_widgets.name: OrderStatusTimeline
shared_widgets.description: Vertical stepper mapping paid→processing, fulfilled→shipped, delivered; cancelled/refunded as terminal states when seeded.

shared_widgets.name: AddressFormUK
shared_widgets.description: Validated UK mainland fields: name, line1, line2 optional, city, postcode; copy notes standard domestic delivery only.

shared_widgets.name: CouponField
shared_widgets.description: Text field + Apply using SecondaryButton; shows server validation errors; one coupon max.

shared_widgets.name: CheckoutSummaryCard
shared_widgets.description: Line items snapshot, subtotal, shipping, discount, total in pence; matches server preview.

shared_widgets.name: MockPaymentPanel
shared_widgets.description: Demo secure payment UI: no PAN/CVV fields; Pay now / Simulate failure buttons calling confirmMockPayment; explanatory copy.

shared_widgets.name: EmptyStateView
shared_widgets.description: Illustration slot, title, body, optional CTA; used for empty cart, wishlist, orders, search.

shared_widgets.name: ErrorStateView
shared_widgets.description: Icon, message, Retry action; distinguishes network vs validation errors.

shared_widgets.name: LoadingSkeleton
shared_widgets.description: Shimmer placeholders for lists, detail, home carousels.

shared_widgets.name: OfflineBanner
shared_widgets.description: Non-blocking banner when API health fails; home/catalog use local fallback catalog.

shared_widgets.name: GuestSignedInBanner
shared_widgets.description: Inline note on cart/checkout indicating guest session or signed-in persistence.

shared_widgets.name: WishlistToggleButton
shared_widgets.description: Heart icon on product detail/list; guests route to Auth; signed-in calls wishlist API.

shared_widgets.name: BottomNavShell
shared_widgets.description: Optional shell with Home, Categories, Cart, Account tabs; badges on cart.

shared_widgets.name: SecureWebView
shared_widgets.description: FAQ/support WebView with UK privacy-safe settings.

shared_widgets.name: SnackbarHost
shared_widgets.description: App-wide snackbars for add-to-cart, merge cart, coupon applied.

screens.name: HomeScreen
screens.purpose: API-backed merchandised entry with banners, featured and new-arrival carousels, category shortcuts, and search entry; falls back to local catalog when health fails.

screens.name: CategoriesScreen
screens.purpose: Browse top-level lighting categories and subcategories; navigate to scoped product listing.

screens.name: ProductListingScreen
screens.purpose: Search, filter, and sort catalog; shows OOS badges; query params: q, categoryId, subcategoryId, sort, filters.

screens.name: ProductDetailScreen
screens.purpose: Gallery, variant selection, specs, reviews preview, add-to-cart, wishlist toggle; bundled product imagery.

screens.name: CartScreen
screens.purpose: Review server cart lines, update quantities, remove items, view subtotal; guest vs signed-in indicator.

screens.name: CheckoutScreen
screens.purpose: UK contact and shipping address, order review, coupon entry, shipping rules and free-delivery threshold copy.

screens.name: MockPaymentScreen
screens.purpose: Mock secure payment step after checkout preview; stock reserved; retry on failure without duplicate paid orders.

screens.name: OrderConfirmationScreen
screens.purpose: Post-payment confirmation with order number, snapshotted lines, address, totals, estimated UK delivery copy.

screens.name: AuthScreen
screens.purpose: Combined login and register tabs; forgot-password request mode; reset-password mode via query token; triggers guest cart merge on success.

screens.name: AccountScreen
screens.purpose: Profile summary, order history entry, wishlist entry, support link, logout, delete account (GDPR).

screens.name: OrderHistoryScreen
screens.purpose: Paginated list of past orders for authenticated customers; guests redirected to auth.

screens.name: OrderDetailScreen
screens.purpose: Order lines with purchase-time snapshots, status timeline, tracking when seeded, totals and shipping address.

screens.name: WishlistScreen
screens.purpose: Registered-user wishlist synced via API; add/remove; navigate to product detail.

screens.name: SupportScreen
screens.purpose: UK customer support contact, hours, phone, email, FAQ WebView; demo catalog disclaimers.

navigation.trigger: Tap search bar or submit query from home
Tap Shop categories or category shortcut
Tap product card or carousel item
Tap cart icon in app bar
Add to cart success snackbar or cart icon
Place order / Continue to payment after valid preview
Mock payment failure — show error and Retry

accessibility: Minimum interactive touch target 48dp on all buttons, steppers, chips, nav icons, and list tiles (expand hit area with padding where visual size is smaller).
All product, category, and icon images include Semantics labels or excludeFromSemantics when decorative with adjacent text.
Color contrast at least WCAG 2.1 AA (4.5:1 normal text, 3:1 large text) for all semantic token pairs including secondary/onSecondary and cartBadge/onCartBadge in light and dark themes.
Support system text scaling up to 200%; layouts use scroll views and do not clip critical actions.
Focus order follows visual order on forms (checkout, auth, address).
Error and validation messages exposed to screen readers via live regions.
Mock payment screen states clearly that card data is not collected on-device or sent to Lumen servers.
Filter and sort sheets trap focus while open and restore focus on dismiss.
Order status timeline steps include combined Semantics labels (status name and date when present).
Cart quantity changes announce updated count and line subtotal.
